			limit = { can_be_employed_as = kehillah_business_market_position }
			save_scope_as = kh_business_candidate

		if = { limit = { exists = scope:kh_business_candidate } appoint_court_position = { recipient = scope:kh_business_candidate court_position = kehillah_business_market_position } clear_saved_scope = kh_business_candidate }

kehillah_business_refresh_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_kehillah exists = primary_title NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_business_refreshing } }
		set_variable = kehillah_business_refreshing
		save_scope_as = kh_business_owner
		primary_title = { save_scope_as = kh_business_title }
		# One-time migration: retire an anonymous commitment only if it has no
		# native appointment behind it. Never clear a newly received native commitment.
		primary_title = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_business_positions_migrated } }
				every_in_list = {
					variable = kehillah_households
					limit = { NOT = { any_house_member = { kehillah_has_business_position_trigger = yes } } }
					remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown
				}
				set_variable = kehillah_business_positions_migrated
			}
		}
		kehillah_business_clear_income_effect = yes
		primary_title = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_built value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_staffed value = 0 }
			clear_variable_list = kehillah_businesses
			every_in_list = {
				variable = kehillah_households
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_household_assignment value = 0 }
			}
		}
		primary_title = {
			remove_variable = kehillah_business_market_operator
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_market_income value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_market_income_value }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_market_output value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_market_output_value }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { employs_court_position = kehillah_business_market_position NOT = { kehillah_business_market_staffed_trigger = yes } }
			every_court_position_holder = {
				type = kehillah_business_market_position
				house ?= { remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown }
				scope:kh_business_owner = { revoke_court_position = { recipient = prev court_position = kehillah_business_market_position } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = yes }
			primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_built add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { kehillah_business_market_staffed_trigger = yes }
				primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_staffed add = 1 } }
				random_court_position_holder = {
					type = kehillah_business_market_position
					scope:kh_business_title = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_market_operator value = prev } }
					house = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_household_assignment value = 1 } }
				}
				if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_03 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_market_income_2 }
				else_if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_02 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_market_income_1 }
				else_if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_01 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_market_income_0 }
				if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_town_sales_01 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_market_income_3 }
			}
		}
		primary_title = {
			remove_variable = kehillah_business_dyers_operator
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_dyers_income value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_dyers_income_value }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_dyers_output value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_dyers_output_value }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { employs_court_position = kehillah_business_dyers_position NOT = { kehillah_business_dyers_staffed_trigger = yes } }
			every_court_position_holder = {
				type = kehillah_business_dyers_position
				house ?= { remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown }
				scope:kh_business_owner = { revoke_court_position = { recipient = prev court_position = kehillah_business_dyers_position } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_business_dyers_built_trigger = yes }
			primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_built add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { kehillah_business_dyers_staffed_trigger = yes }
				primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_staffed add = 1 } }
				random_court_position_holder = {
					type = kehillah_business_dyers_position
					scope:kh_business_title = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_dyers_operator value = prev } }
					house = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_household_assignment value = 1 } }
				}
				if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_trade_dyers_02 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_dyers_income_1 }
				else_if = { limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_trade_dyers_01 } } add_character_modifier = kehillah_business_dyers_income_0 }
			}
		}
		primary_title = {
			remove_variable = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_operator
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_income value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_silk_weavers_income_value }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_output value = scope:kh_business_owner.kehillah_business_silk_weavers_output_value }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { employs_court_position = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_position NOT = { kehillah_business_silk_weavers_staffed_trigger = yes } }
			every_court_position_holder = {
				type = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_position
				house ?= { remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown }
				scope:kh_business_owner = { revoke_court_position = { recipient = prev court_position = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_position } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_business_silk_weavers_built_trigger = yes }
			primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_built add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { kehillah_business_silk_weavers_staffed_trigger = yes }
				primary_title = { change_variable = { name = kehillah_business_staffed add = 1 } }
				random_court_position_holder = {
					type = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_position
					scope:kh_business_title = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_operator value = prev } }
					house = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_household_assignment value = 1 } }
				}

		}
		remove_variable = kehillah_business_refreshing
	}
}
